gameDescriptionHtml:
Locomoto is a cosy, life-sim adventure train game where you are the conductor! Customise, manage and expand your train as well as tend to your colourful, furry passengers. Board your train and embark on a journey through beautiful landscapes, all while enjoying the soft, lofi beats of an extensive original soundtrack.

Game Features

  • Train Life – Ensure your passengers have the best journey possible. Invite passengers to board your train and help them reach their destinations. Serve your passengers to make sure they’re having a comfortable journey. Tend to your train and prepare it for the next journey.
  • Customise Your Experience – Customise your train by decorating your wagons with furniture in different styles! Craft the furniture you need using resources scoured around the world. Using different resources to influence the colours of your crafted item. Expand your train by adding more wagons, allowing more passengers to ride along! Customise your look! Choose between a great variety of animal-like features and colours, then play around with an assorted collection of clothes, that you collect throughout your journey, to express yourself further!
  • Explore the World – Explore, interact and engage with unique characters. Help them with their requests to gain rewards of clothes, resources and crafting-blueprints. As you befriend them, learn more about their personalities and struggles within the world.
